status: unrefereed research candidate; internal AI-assisted review only
object: Stationary binary alternating-renewal law P_q, 0<q<1: A dwell Exp(1+q); B dwell transform [(2q/(1+q))z + 1+q+q^2]/[z^2 + 2(1+q)z + 1+q+q^2]. V_n(P) = least entropy-production rate over n-state CTMC realisations with a deterministic binary labelling reproducing the complete stationary observed law.

claims.statement: Three states are the fewest realising P_q; V_3(P_q) = (1-q) log(1/q), uniquely attained (up to B-state exchange) by the homogeneous driven ring; the same lower bound holds for any number of A states with at most two B states.
For every 0<q<1 an explicit finite four-state exact realisation of P_q has strictly smaller entropy production: V_4(P_q) < V_3(P_q); rational q admits rational rates.
At q=1/20 the rational generator Q_* realises P_{1/20} with sigma(Q_*) = 2.773076657835..., below V_3 = (19/20) log 20 = 2.845945659876...
At q=1/20 a rational four-state generator has sigma = 2.7659977105... and a rational five-state generator has sigma = 2.7469854029..., both exact realisations of P_{1/20}.

For any finite stationary CTMC and binary partition with entrance intensity r, mean complete B dwell m and initial dwell density f_0, if 0 < k = m f_0 < 1 then sigma(Q) > 4 r sqrt(1-k) artanh sqrt(1-k); if f_0 = 0 entropy production is infinite. No renewal assumption.

Over all finite architectures with fixed (r, m, f_0), 0<rm<1: the infimum is 4 r sqrt(1-k) artanh sqrt(1-k) when 0<k<1, approached by three-state models with diverging internal rates and attained by no finite model; for k >= 1 a reversible model with at most three states attains zero.

(2/3)(1-q) log(1/q) <= V_inf(P_q) <= V_4(P_q) < V_3(P_q); at q=1/20, 1.897297106584... <= V_inf(P_{1/20}) <= 2.746985402969..., the floor being about 108 times the floor certified in the earlier Evidence Press candidate (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23118474).
Numerical optimisation puts the four-state optimum at q=1/20 at about 2.765996 and indicates that a fifth state lowers the cost further.
Exact values of V_4(P_q) and V_inf(P_q), and finite attainment of V_inf under the fixed complete law.

scope: No four-state or unrestricted optimum is claimed. The fixed-statistics sharpness sequences change the full dwell law and are not exact-law sequences for P_q. No experimental estimate or statistical coverage is given.
